IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: House Early Learning & Human Services (originally sponsored by Representative Hunt)

Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning minimum educational licensing requirements for family day care providers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to education requirements for family day careproviders; and adding a new section to chapter 43.215 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.215 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A family day care provider may meet the minimum educationrequirement for licensing by achieving a level three rating in theearly achievers program, Washington state's quality rating improvementsystem.
